name: glitch-shop
description: Glitch Shop - Tienda de videojuegos, consolas, accesorios y merchandising (México). Vanilla HTML + CSS + JS con Supabase Auth/DB + Checkout WhatsApp al propietario.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const root=p.resolve('.');const pub=p.join(root,'public');const rm=(d)=>{if(fs.existsSync(d))for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const s=p.join(d,f);if(fs.lstatSync(s).isDirectory())rm(s);else fs.unlinkSync(s)}fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})};if(fs.existsSync(pub))rm(pub);fs.mkdirSync(pub,{recursive:true});const copy=(s,d)=>{fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(d),{recursive:true});if(fs.lstatSync(s).isDirectory()){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s))copy(p.join(s,f),p.join(d,f))}else fs.copyFileSync(s,d)};for(const f of ['index.html','catalogo.html','login.html','admin.html','styles.css','script.js','vercel.json','.env.local.example'])copy(p.join(root,f),p.join(pub,f));for(const f of ['imagenes','supabase'])if(fs.existsSync(p.join(root,f)))copy(p.join(root,f),p.join(pub,f));console.log('Build OK: files copied to /public')"

author: Glitch Shop
